metadata.title: Neuron: Resource-Aware Permission Governance for Dependable Multi-Tenant LLM Agent Runtimes (Computing replication package)
metadata.description: Replication package for the Computing manuscript on resource pressure, permission-decision availability, and cross-layer coupling in a Java 21 multi-tenant agent runtime. Includes source, raw JSONL observations, environment records, analysis scripts, generated values, and a flat Springer submission tree. The permission-service deployment is same-host loopback only and does not represent WAN or multi-node behavior.
